visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of the Simose Art Museum, a modern structure with large glass panels reflecting the surrounding sea and sky. A woman in a white shirt and black trousers walks towards the entrance. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of the museum, featuring a striking wooden lattice ceiling structure that curves down like a tree. A white circular reception desk is central, and the space is flooded with natural light from floor-to-ceiling windows. (3) Outside on a waterfront terrace, eight brightly colored, floating exhibition boxes in hues of red, yellow, and green sit on a pool of water, with mountains in the background. (4) Inside a white-walled gallery, a woman with long dark hair, wearing a brown sweater and carrying a grey tote bag, views a small painting. The environment is minimalist and brightly lit. (5) A transition shows the museum's cafe area where visitors sit at light wood tables, enjoying the view of the Seto Inland Sea through the glass walls. (6) The woman walks through 'The Outlets Hiroshima', a large outdoor shopping mall with white canopies and numerous storefronts under a clear blue sky. (7) Interior of an 'AEON STYLE' supermarket shows a man standing near shelves of fresh fruit, with bright industrial lighting. (8) The scene moves to a modern hotel room at Hotel Granvia Hiroshima, featuring two twin beds with white linens, light wood furniture, and a large window overlooking the city. (9) At the '廣島燒 SOZO' restaurant, a chef uses metal spatulas to cook layered okonomiyaki on a large flat griddle. Steam rises as ingredients are pressed and flipped. (10) A close-up shows the finished okonomiyaki topped with a fried egg and green onions being sliced and served. (11) The woman walks past the Atomic Bomb Dome, a skeletal historical structure surrounded by green lawns and a dark metal fence. (12) At the Hiroshima Orizuru Tower, the woman stands on a wooden observation deck overlooking the city. She is then seen folding a green paper crane and dropping it into a tall glass collection wall. (13) The woman walks down a spiral walkway featuring large colorful murals with themes of peace and nature. (14) At '牡蠣船 KANAWA', a pot of oyster stew with leeks and tofu boils on a burner. A woman is seen eating a raw oyster from its shell. (15) In a cozy cafe named 'Progress LIFE STYLE COFFEE', the woman walks up a wooden staircase decorated with art. Close-ups show a cup of coffee and a dessert topped with figs. (16) A wide shot captures Hiroshima Castle, a traditional multi-tiered black and white structure, framed by trees with autumn leaves. (17) The video concludes in a bright, modern souvenir shop at the 'minamoa' facility, showing shelves stocked with various packaged snacks and gifts.
